subject: Retention vs Trace: proposal for split billing and pilot credits
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily.park@clearwavehealth.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearwavehealth.com
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify billing approach for retention + tracing add-ons

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team was impressed with the dashboard previews and the trace sampling options. Procurement asked me to follow up on two things before we finalize the SOW:

1) We need a clear billing split between retention (archival bytes / month) and tracing (trace ingestion + query costs). Finance wants to avoid a single monolithic line item.
2) We expected some pilot credits for the dashboard proof-of-value. Can you confirm what you can offer for a 90-day pilot (we'll send synthetic data for the trial)?

Also, is there a straightforward way to cap monthly egress/query spend during the pilot? They asked specifically about a hard cap or a soft alert.

Appreciate any detail you can share — procurement is aiming to close this by the end of next week.

Best,
Emily
Emily Park
Head of Platform Engineering
ClearWave Health
[Attachment: ClearWave_SOW_v0.9.docx]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, procurement@clearwavehealth.com
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify billing approach for retention + tracing add-ons

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up front, then I’ll outline a recommended structure:

- Split billing: yes, we can present retention (storage/archival) and tracing (ingest + query) as two separate line items in the SOW.
- Pilot credits: we can provide a 90-day pilot credit package — details below.
- Spend cap: we can set a monthly hard cap on query egress for the pilot or configure alerts + automatic rollback to sampling if you prefer soft controls.

Proposed pilot offer (for ClearWave Health):
- 90-day pilot, up to 6 TB of retention credits (applies to archive/long-term store).
- 500k trace ingestions credit + 20k query units (query units are our internal metric; we’ll map to estimated monthly cost on the SOW).
- If you exceed the pilot cap, we’ll pause heavy query workloads and send an alert; we can also enable an opt-in pay-as-you-go top-up so you never get blocked.

Commercial structure we recommend for the long-term SOW:
1) Retention: tiered per-GB monthly pricing with a graduated step-down at 5 TB and 20 TB buckets. Line item in SOW called “Retention — long-term store (GB/mo)”.
2) Tracing: two-line model — (a) ingestion (events/month), (b) query/runtime (query units).
3) Dashboards/advanced visuals: one-time enablement fee + per-seat support surcharge if you want dedicated views/white-glove dashboards.

I’m copying Ben (revenue) and Irene (security/compliance) for quick confirmation on credit size and any constraints from SOC2 controls around synthetic data ingestion.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Commercials — Redwood Inference
redwood.com
[Attachment: pricing-breakdown-retain-trace.xlsx]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify billing approach for retention + tracing add-ons

Laura/Irene — quick internal note on concessions.

I’m comfortable with the proposed pilot credits but recommend we tie the 6 TB retention credit to a usage ramp schedule: 0-30 days (max 1.5 TB), 31-60 (up to 3.0 TB), 61-90 (up to 6 TB). That prevents a customer from loading the entire credit bucket on day one for archival bulk import.

Discounting: for an annual commit we can offer:
- 10% off combined add-ons at $120k annualized spend
- 18% off at $300k annualized spend (requires exec approval)

Also, suggest we offer a 30% enablement discount on dashboard enablement for the pilot if they sign into a 12-month CT (commit term).

Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

On a compliance flag: Irene — do we need an explicit clause restricting synthetic PHI in the pilot? If so, we should put a short data-use note in the SOW and provide a temporary ingestion filter we control on our side.

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify billing approach for retention + tracing add-ons

Agree with the ramp and the discounts. A couple compliance points to include in the SOW:

- Data classification: call out that synthetic test data is allowed for the pilot; any PHI-like payloads require a signed DPA addendum and must be sent to a restricted ingestion endpoint.
- Audit logs: ClearWave will receive limited audit access during the pilot (summary events). Full audit retention (90+ days) is an add-on.
- Security review: we can grant scoped, time-boxed access to the test environment for 3rd-party auditors if necessary, but requires an NDA addition.

I’ll draft a short clause and attach for Laura to include in the SOW.

Irene
Irene Choi
Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@clearwavehealth.com>, procurement@clearwavehealth.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Clarify billing approach for retention + tracing add-ons

Emily — thank you, and appreciate the quick timeline. Below is the concise offer we can include in an updated SOW and commercial term sheet: 

Offer summary (ClearWave Health pilot + SOW framing)
- Pilot: 90 days starting on sign (or on productive data ingest whichever is later).
  * Retention credits: ramped allocation — month1: 1.5 TB, month2: 3.0 TB, month3: 6.0 TB.
  * Trace credits: 500k ingest events + 20k query units across 90 days.
  * Dashboard enablement: waived enablement fee for pilot; 30% discount on one-time enablement if you convert to a 12-month CT.
- Spend controls: we will configure a hard monthly cap for query units during the pilot. If the cap is reached, queries will be limited and an automated alert will be sent to your team and ours. Optional pay-as-you-go top-up available if you want to avoid throttling.
- Billing presentation: SOW will show three separate line items — Retention (GB/mo), Tracing (ingest + query), Advanced Dashboards (one-time + seats).
- Discounts on conversion: 10% off add-ons at $120k ANR, 18% at $300k ANR (exec-signed).
- Compliance notes: synthetic test data allowed; any real PHI requires DPA addendum and restricted ingestion endpoint. Audit-log retention beyond pilot is billable as an add-on.

Next steps:
1) If that aligns, Emily — confirm pilot start date and whether procurement needs the SOW with the ramp table included (we can attach a small schedule).
2) I’ll upload the updated SOW (v1) and pricing worksheet to DocuSign for signature and route to Ben to prepare the commercial terms.

Attached: pricing-breakdown-retain-trace.xlsx, draft SOW stub.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if procurement wants to walk the schedule.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Director, Commercials — Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
[Attachment: ClearWave_SOW_v1.pdf, pricing-breakdown-retain-trace.xlsx]
